supersedes: rth_continuation_v1 (hash 977d4c124a257b14): committed, never registered or scored
question: At 09:45, 10:00 and 10:15 ET, do the RTH analogues' next 15 minutes describe the target session's next 15 minutes better than (a) the frozen pre-open analogue set and (b) a same-clock historical baseline - for the size of the move and for its direction, measured separately?
matcher: nq_match_rth_v2 (weights and tolerances frozen; tolerances calibrated on sessions to 2026-10-07 only)
move: (close of the bar ending at cutoff + 15 min - close of the bar ending at the cutoff) / that session's frozen daily ATR (its pre-open snapshot), from confirmed 1-minute bars on its active contract

forecasts.stored: at issue, by the same run that stores the live RTH set of the cutoff's window (journal.rth_eval_forecasts): every forecast's members with session, context snapshot, contract, similarity, weight and move, the versions and the pre-open set used - never rebuilt; the scorer only adds the target's realised move
forecasts.weights: equal: 1 / n over the members with a move
forecasts.RTH-20: primary: the 20 highest similarities of the matcher's ranking at the cutoff (the live set's own ranking)
forecasts.RTH-5: secondary: the live set's five members - what was on screen
forecasts.PRE-5: baseline: the members of the target's pre-open analogue set (nq_match_p1_v2, rules protocol), the newest stored when the forecast is issued
forecasts.CLOCK: baseline: every session of the matcher's scored pool at the cutoff - the same-clock history
forecasts.member_move: a member's own move over the same clock window, from its bars as stored at issue; a member without the whole window is left out of that forecast (counted)

eligibility.provenance_apart: who issued a set and when its inputs reached the store are provenance; whether a forecast counts is decided separately, from the database's stamp of when it was stored
eligibility.rule: eligible only when stored within 14 minutes of its cutoff - before its 15-minute window ends; a forecast stored after the window ends never counts. The database stamps the time and decides (the limit is read from this registered definition)
eligibility.feed: on the user's ~10-minute-delayed feed a forecast is issued about 12 minutes into its window: the evaluation measures the information at the cutoff, out of sample (nothing after the cutoff is read), not a tradeable lead time
eligibility.first_counts: one forecast per session and cutoff: the first stored; a later issue of the same cutoff is not stored

cases.universe: every scheduled NQ session from the day this definition is registered, at each of the three cutoffs

reasons.not_issued: no forecast stored for the cutoff (Auto not running, no live RTH set of that window)
reasons.unverified_inputs: its RTH set's inputs not verified as of the cutoff (pit_status)
reasons.forecast_incomplete: a forecast with fewer members with a move than {"RTH-20": 10, "RTH-5": 3, "PRE-5": 3, "CLOCK": 30}
reasons.outcome_pending: the window has not ended, or its bars are not all confirmed yet
reasons.outcome_missing: the session's bars of the window are incomplete (a gap) - never filled in

cases.order: the first reason that applies, in the order above; every case is reported under one
cases.scored: a case with none of these reasons

scores.size: fair ensemble CRPS (Ferro 2014: no penalty for the number of members) of |y| against the members' |moves|
scores.direction: Brier score of p_up = (members up + 1) / (members + 2) against y > 0 (y = 0 counts as not up)
scores.signed: secondary: fair ensemble CRPS of y against the members' moves

aggregation: per session, the difference of the two scores averaged over its scored cutoffs (sessions weigh equally); each cutoff also reported alone (secondary)

endpoint.counts: a session counts when at least one of its cutoffs is scored
endpoint.when: the first scoring at or after 60 counted sessions - or on 2027-06-30, whichever comes first, then only with at least 30 counted sessions (else reported as insufficient, no comparison)
endpoint.once: scored once; the stored result stands. Sixty sessions is a checkpoint, not a promise of a conclusive result - more data means a new version
endpoint.before: until then only operational health is looked at (rth-eval-status: cases by reason, issue delays, member counts) - never a score

uncertainty: the mean of the session differences; an interval from a circular moving-block bootstrap over sessions in date order (blocks of 5, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261009), percentile, each primary at 98.75 % (95 % Bonferroni over the four)
decision: a primary comparison shows RTH-20 better only when its whole interval lies below zero (a lower score is better); otherwise: no sufficiently reliable improvement was established - never 'ruled out'. Size and direction are concluded separately; the five displayed analogues are never the probability model
display: none while the evaluation runs: no analogue continuation, frequency or path is aggregated or overlaid on the dashboard
